contact_tolerances: inherited3mm vertical,2mm horizontal; strict correct-key region unchanged
finger_label_independent: Uses original predicted HAND active-key sets; no independence from hand-label errors claimed. UNKNOWN hand excluded, no reassignment.

placement_not_contact.rationale: Coarse placement permits half a white key width horizontally and inherited full white-key10mm travel vertically. This is NOT a relaxed contact PASS. Strict contact feasibility also reported separately with inherited tolerances.

failure_attribution_precedence: labeled fails but strict injective unlabeled matching passes -> LIKELY_FINGERING_LABEL_CONFLICT
strict unlabeled fails but coarse injective matching passes -> SOURCE_2_5D_OR_CONTACT_PRECISION_LIMIT
coarse fails but injected horizontal/depth matching without height passes AND no duplicate predicted finger -> DEPTH_OR_APPROACH_ORIENTATION_LIMIT
attribution_caution: These are operational conditional diagnostics, not causal ground truth. Geometric failure at fitted pose does not prove all legal poses impossible.
failed_pose_without_causal_evidence: Do not assert model architecture failure solely from unknown/predicted fingers or nonmetric source.
